title: tephrocactus aoracanthus var. paediophilus
intro: Tephrocactus aoracanthus var. paediophilus, commonly known as "little child lover" or "paedophilus prickly pear," is a species of cactus native to Mexico. It belongs to the family Cactaceae, characterized by its distinctive spiny stems and vibrant flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits in reducing fever and inflammation, as well as its therapeutic actions as a purgative and anti-inflammatory. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
